title: Useless
body:
Useless for me. 
The app makes a lot of promises and gives the impression that it offers something powerful, but I found no real value in it.

It feels more like a way to get you into a subscription than a genuinely useful product. 

Update: The developer has refunded my payment as promised, so I appreciate that. The app itself still wasn’t useful for me and didn’t meet my expectations, but the refund issue was resolved.
author: Kons1010

title: 100% scam
body: I bought a trail subscription for 3$. I wanted to cancel that because I didn’t like that app, but subscription wasn’t displayed in my apple account. I assumed that trial period was just over and subscription cancelled automatically. After a some while about 70$ was charged from my bank account. I had to dig deep to figure out where is money went. I found a developer’s web site, contacted a support with email explaining that I hadn’t intended to purchase a full subscription, that it wasn’t listed in my apple account and I had no way of knowing about that. I requested a refund, but support didn’t  respond. Give me my money back!
